identity.name: Prospex Turtle
identity.one_liner: A revival of Seiko's 1976 cushion-cased dive watch, discontinued around 2021 and replaced by the near-identical SRPE93.

narrative.story: The SRP777 revived Seiko's 1976 'Turtle' dive watch case — a cushion-shaped, asymmetric profile named for its resemblance to a turtle shell — running caliber 4R36 in a black-dialed, 44.3mm case. Seiko released it in early 2016 as part of the modern Prospex relaunch and discontinued it around 2021, replacing it with the near-identical SRPE93, whose main change was updating the caseback text from 'air diver's' to 'diver's watch' to meet ISO water-resistance labeling standards.
narrative.collector_notes: Functionally identical to its SRPE93 successor apart from caseback wording; choosing between a used SRP777 and a new SRPE93 mostly comes down to price and condition rather than spec differences.
